sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "matches"."winner_id" AS e, "players"."hand" AS g, AVG((CAST(("matches"."winner_rank_points" - "matches"."loser_rank_points") AS REAL) / "matches"."loser_rank_points")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "matches" JOIN "players" ON "players"."player_id" = "matches"."winner_id"  GROUP BY "matches"."winner_id", "players"."hand"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m2" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "s3"."g" AS g, AVG("s3"."m1") AS m1, SUM("s3"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s3"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s3" GROUP BY "s3"."g"
quantities: matches.relative difference of winner ranking points from loser ranking points
why: (winner ranking points - loser ranking points) / loser ranking points: the relative difference of two quantities in points
average of relative difference of winner ranking points from loser ranking points per players within players.hand
share of the all total of number of matches records (all level)
coarsen to g: AVG (averaged), SUM (additive), AVG (averaged)
